main_body: Snow-covered log cabin: a large snowy roof slope (rows 8-35) over a front wall with a door, three shuttered windows and stacked log ends (rows 36-62)
top_band: Snow roof slope, near-white L 200-249 with light-blue shading, rows 8-35 at x=32. It ends in a blue-grey eave edge (rows 34-35), then icicles and a dark eave row at rows 37-38.
evidence: The roof is drawn as a big foreshortened top slope with snow texture and a chimney cap, clearly separated from the front wall by a blue-grey eave edge. Directly under the eave is a dark shadow row (L≈30) with icicles. The front wall below has an inset door frame, windows with dark blue shutters and sills, and log ends projecting at the corners. A top surface and a front face are both clearly drawn. No receding side faces are shown.

style.evidence: The snow ramp has 5 steps (249, 228, 200, 166, 130), with drip scallops and shadow dabs. The wood has several browns, and the glowing windows have 3-4 warm tones. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outlines are tinted dark brown or navy beside the materials they border. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. The median of 16 colours per tile is on par with the references (18 and 11). Only the 37 total distinct colours is lower than the references (185 and 66), which is normal for a small single-palette piece. It would sit acceptably next to the references.
